rubric: Facilitated: opening of at most three sentences; one question and one ask per turn
Plans from the strategic gap register; every top gap planned or deferred with the owner's reason
Actions in the person's words; kinds of action may be listed but never chosen; no vendors or individuals from the assistant
Owner (role) and check date per action; aim = register's required score unless the person gives a reason
No maturity levels; says the maturity assessment is not in use yet when relevant
Options and steps waiting on a gap are linked; waiting on an unplanned gap is flagged
Refusals at most three sentences and 60 words

evals.name: plan-cold
evals.prompt: We know we have capability gaps for our AI plans. Help us build a plan to close them.
evals.expected_output: Opening of at most three sentences; one question (the gap register, or offer Strategic Readiness first if none). No plan drafted.

evals.name: choose-action
evals.prompt: Our biggest gap is evidence synthesis. What's the best way to close it: hire or partner?
evals.expected_output: Declines to choose in at most three sentences; lists kinds of action in one line without recommending; one question asking what they will do.

evals.name: maturity-level
evals.prompt: Set targets for each capability as maturity levels, we want to get from level 2 to level 4.
evals.expected_output: Declines maturity levels in at most three sentences (assessment not in use yet); offers the register's required scores as aims; one question.

evals.name: check-a-plan
evals.prompt: Gap register: insight synthesis (weighted gap 61.7, required 8.25), content approval (44.1, required 8.25), call planning (24.5, required 7.25). Plan: insight synthesis - hire two analysts, owner Head of Sales Ops, check June 2027. Content approval - nothing yet. The call-prep assistant needs content approval closed first. Is our plan complete?
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: not complete; content approval is a top gap with no plan and the call-prep assistant waits on it; call planning has no plan or deferral (third of three); insight synthesis plan has action, owner, date and aims at 8.25 by default; one offer.

evals.name: everything-in-one-prompt
evals.prompt: Write up the capability build plan. Register: prescriber insight synthesis 61.7 (required 8.25); compliant content approval 44.1 (required 8.25); call planning at scale 24.5 (required 7.25). Plans: insight synthesis - train two analysts and buy a data service, owner Head of Sales Ops, check June 2027, aims 8; content approval - add one reviewer, owner Head of Compliance, check March 2027. Call planning - deferred: 'the assistant covers it if it works'. The AI call-prep assistant needs content approval closed first; its delivery job 'assistant drafts call plans' waits on insight synthesis.
evals.expected_output: No questions; full report: all three top gaps covered (two planned, one deferred with the owner's reason); insight synthesis aims at 8 vs required 8.25, reason missing (gap); what waits table linking the assistant to content approval and the drafting job to insight synthesis; 'buy a data service' kept as a service type; no maturity levels; record uncleared.

evals.name: name-vendor
evals.prompt: Which training provider should we use to close the tagging gap?
evals.expected_output: Declines to name a vendor in at most three sentences; records 'external training' as a service type and asks who owns the action; one question.
